info.text: The functional design meeting will include presentations from the industrial designer, user interface designer, and marketing expert.
The remote control should be powerful, with many functions, and easy to use.
The user interface designer is tasked with making the remote control intuitive and easy to use.
The industrial designer is asked about the feasibility of having a link between the remote control and the TV.
The remote control should have a balance between function and cost.
New project requirements include: no teletext, remote control only for TV, and a focus on being fashionable, powerful, and easy to use.
The remote control should be yellow and recognizable as a 'real reaction' product.
The team will have 30 minutes of individual work to initialize their designs.

summary: The remote control should be powerful, easy to use, and fashionable. It will be yellow and have a balance between function and cost. The design team will meet to discuss and initialize their designs.

info.text: remote TV control has very sophisticated functions, over 12 or 20 functions
design an elegant, easy-to-use interface, like Google
My job is to design a Google TV controller with sophisticated functions, yet easy to use
a good user interface takes less time for users to learn how to use it
it's possible to mix several functions in one button to have less buttons
users are not happy to read the manual
categorize functions into classes and use a switch menu to reduce buttons

summary: Design an elegant Google TV controller with 12+ sophisticated functions. Categorize functions into classes and use a switch menu to minimize buttons. Offer design options like color to users, ensuring an easy-to-use interface that requires less learning time.

info.text: 75% of users find most remote controls ugly.
80% of users would spend more money if remote controls were not so ugly.
Remote controls often have too many buttons.
Users are using remote controls intensively.
Only 10% of buttons on a remote control are actually used.
Remote controls are often lost in the room.
35% of people find it takes too much time to learn how to use a remote control.
26% of users experience RSI problems with remote controls.
RSI is an injury caused by repetitive movements.
A potential solution is to make remote controls look fancy and have fewer buttons.

summary: 75% of users find remote controls ugly. 80% would pay more for a better design. A potential solution is to make remotes look fancy with fewer buttons, addressing issues like 35% of users struggling to learn usage and 26% experiencing RSI problems.
